question: In the UK, alcohol cannot be sold to anyone under the age of:
explanation: It is unlawful to sell alcohol to someone under 18. In England, Wales and Scotland, 16- and 17-year-olds accompanied by an adult may drink (but not buy) beer, wine or cider with a table meal in licensed premises.
